title: Right derivation preserves finite adjunction conjugacy
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y and an integer n≥0. Use the intrinsic finite derived adjunction finiteAdj of [def-sf-integral-system-operations] and the native finite derived adjunction levelAdj of [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. Let nativeFinitePullIso be the explicit ordinary left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism of [lem-sf-integral-native-ordinary-comparison]. The conjugate of its exact localization under finiteAdj and levelAdj is the inverse of the right-derived compactSupportDirectModel isomorphism. This is equality of natural transformations on the full unbounded derived module category.

source.place: Coefficient comparisons preserve evaluation and adjunction units/counits; primitive whole-system operation comparison in Step 1 of lem-sf-integral-support-strict-tower-comparison. Stacks 03DI, 0941, 0D6E; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10.

proof.text: For exact additive left adjoints L₁,L₂ with right adjoints R₁,R₂, prove that right derivation of an ordinary conjugacy is the conjugacy of the localized left-adjoint isomorphism. Use rightDerived_ext on homotopy inputs, the derived unit/counit factor equations and naturality. Lift each homotopy input to a complex; verify the remaining ordinary conjugacy equation in each degree.

Apply this calculation to nativeFinitePullIso.symm. Its ordinary conjugate is compactSupportDirectModel by the ordinary uniqueness counit calculation. Invert the resulting isomorphism equality to obtain the finite derived conjugate formula.

theorem finite_derived_conjugate {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := ProEtale.StrictTower.modulePullback_additive (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) f
    letI := ProEtale.StrictTower.modulePullback_finiteLimits (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) f
    letI := ProEtale.StrictTower.modulePullback_finiteColimits (compactSupportSystemLevel l E n) f
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_additive (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteLimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    letI := sfIntrinsicPullback_preservesFiniteColimits (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f
    letI := proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage_additive f
      (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1))
    conjugateEquiv (finiteAdj l E f n)
      (ProEtale.VaryingRing.levelAdj (compactSupportSystemLevel l E) f n)
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (nativeFinitePullIso l E f n)).hom =
    (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorNatIso
      (compactSupportDirectModel f (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)))).inv
